name: responsive-cache-cleaner
description: Firefox + Chrome extension that keeps HTTP/Cache Storage fresh during responsive and layout testing

scripts.lint: npx --yes web-ext@10.8.0 lint --source-dir . --ignore-files node_modules test package.json package-lock.json scripts web-ext-artifacts
scripts.build: npx --yes web-ext@10.8.0 build --source-dir . --overwrite-dest --ignore-files node_modules test package.json package-lock.json scripts web-ext-artifacts
scripts.check:syntax: node --check background.js && node --check popup.js && node --check options.js && node --check lib/settings.js && node --check lib/scope.js && node --check lib/clear-types.js && node --check lib/browser-api.js
